lines.text: The kitchen smells of garlic and simmering gravy[cite: 9].

lines.speaker: MARIA
lines.text: Sit down, Luca. Your father's late[cite: 9, 10].

lines.speaker: LUCA
lines.text: He's always late. Or dead. Pick one[cite: 10].

lines.speaker: MARIA
lines.text: We don't say that. Family first[cite: 10].
